papers.title: Influence of process parameters on the correlation between in-situ process monitoring data and the mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V non-stochastic cellular structures
papers.first_author_affiliation: I-Form Advanced Manufacturing Research Centre, School of Mechanical and Materials Engineering, University College Dublin, Belfield, Dublin. 4, Ireland

corresponding_authors.name: Darragh S. Egan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: I-Form Advanced Manufacturing Research Centre, School of Mechanical and Materials Engineering, University College Dublin, Belfield, Dublin. 4, Ireland

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究Ti-6Al-4V多孔结构的LPBF工艺参数与力学性能的关系，直接支持生物医学植入物的力学匹配设计。
llm.why_not_core: Does not explicitly address stress shielding or fatigue behavior, and lacks surface roughness or osseointegration analysis for biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索工艺参数对多孔结构力学性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过原位监测数据和力学测试建立相关性
summary_zh.result: 确定了关键工艺参数对力学性能的影响规律

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of LPBF process parameters on the mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V cellular structures.
summary_en.method: Correlated in-situ process monitoring data with post-build mechanical testing results.
summary_en.result: Identified key process parameters that significantly affect stiffness and strength of cellular structures.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical compression tests on fabricated specimens.
